P15-22.name: Sisters' Syndrome
P15-22.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Flash]
During this turn, give two opposing Spirits/Ultimates -3000 BP. Spirits/Ultimates whose BP are brought to 0 by this effect are destroyed. Also, if [Soul Core](Soul Core) was used to pay the cost, refresh a [Shiny Hearts] or [Twilight Gothic] Spirit you control. Then, you can put this Magic card onto your Field.

PB48-CP04.name: ［Supernova］Diana Fleur
PB48-CP04.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Fleur" & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[teams: Twilight Gothic Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Fleur" attacks, for each Magic card with [Song] on your Field, you can send a core from the opposing Field to the Trash.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash -
Once per turn, by returning a Magic card with [Song] from your Field to the Hand, refresh a "Fleur" you control.

PB48-X01.name: ［Supernova］Noa Fleur
PB48-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Fleur" & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[teams: Shiny Hearts Twilight Gothic]

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and when destroys, if there is "Noa Fleur" among this Spirit's pre-advent cards, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2]
The part of your "Fleur" effects that target opposing Spirits/Nexuses can't be prevented by opposing effects.

PB48-CP03.name: ［Together Forever］Diana Fleur
PB48-CP03.effect:
[teams: Twilight Gothic Shiny Hearts]

While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when your Hand or the opposing Hand increases via this Spirit's effect, you can immediately use one of the Flash effects of a Magic card with [Song] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +2. Then, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, add either a "Fleur", or a Magic card with [Song] to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

PB48-CX01.name: ［Together Forever］Noa Fleur
PB48-CX01.effect:
[teams: Shiny Hearts Twilight Gothic]

While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, when opposing Spirits would leave the Field due to this Spirit, you can pay one cost to summon from your Hand a "Fleur"/"Spitz Dracony" with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counter +2. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, and draw a card from the deckbottom.
